reason: Conversation 1 correctly identifies the drying heater circuit (heater, thermal cut-out/thermostat) from the first turn, confirms the programme and cold-tap/spin factors with sensible questions, gives safe guidance (unplug before removing the top, don't touch wiring or test live), and escalates appropriately to an engineer without naming parts or suggesting a bypass. Conversation 2 wasted two turns insisting on a pump-filter check that cannot explain a stone-cold heater with fan and drum running, repeated itself verbatim when the customer pushed back, and only reached the correct heater/thermostat diagnosis after the customer did the reasoning. Conversation 1's one weakness is dismissing the interrupted-cycle link to a thermal cut-out trip, but it still lands on the right direction and engineer escalation far more efficiently.
